mapper.insert: INSERT INTO showcase_shop(owner_username,name,cover_url,description,contact,status) SELECT u.username,#{record.name},#{record.coverUrl},#{record.description},#{record.contact},'PENDING' FROM vip_user u WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.status='ENABLED' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name=IF(showcase_shop.status='REJECTED',#{record.name},showcase_shop.name), cover_url=IF(showcase_shop.status='REJECTED',#{record.coverUrl},showcase_shop.cover_url), description=IF(showcase_shop.status='REJECTED',#{record.description},showcase_shop.description), contact=IF(showcase_shop.status='REJECTED',#{record.contact},showcase_shop.contact), status=CASE WHEN showcase_shop.status='REJECTED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE showcase_shop.status END

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO showcase_product(shop_id,type_id,title,category,cover_url,summary,content,price,stock,status,sort_order,published_at) SELECT s.id,#{record.typeId},#{record.title},#{record.category},#{record.coverUrl},#{record.summary},#{record.content},#{record.price},#{record.stock},#{record.status},#{record.sortOrder}, CASE WHEN #{record.status}='PUBLISHED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END FROM showcase_shop s JOIN vip_user u ON u.username=s.owner_username WHERE s.owner_username=#{username} AND u.status='ENABLED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM showcase_shop_type t JOIN showcase_shop_type_rel r ON r.type_code=t.type_code WHERE r.shop_id=s.id AND t.id=#{record.typeId} AND t.status='ENABLED') AND s.status='ACTIVE'
